page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, each of the 128 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core, eliminating resource sharing at the thread level. The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor to manage virtualization. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication with external storage volumes and other network resources. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads, allowing organizations to consolidate large-scale databases or in-memory applications onto a single node rather than distributing them across multiple smaller instances. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance without virtualization overhead. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale enterprise databases, in-memory caching systems, real-time data processing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
